title: Thekga My Quiet Bible
description: My Quiet Bible ke ya mahala go bohle, go ya go ile. Ge e go thuša, o ka thuša go boloka lebone le tuka.
sub: Ke ya mahala go bohle, go ya go ile. Ge e go thuša, o ka thuša go boloka lebone le tuka.
kofiSub: Gatee, goba kgwedi ye nngwe le ye nngwe. Ka karata, Apple Pay goba Google Pay, ga go nyakege go ingwadiša.
leave: E bulega letlakaleng le leswa. Boela mo, goba Beibeleng, ge o feditše.
btcSub: On-chain goba Lightning, thwi go seva ya rena, ntle le motho wa magareng goba motho wa boraro.
btcAddressQr: Khoutu ya QR ya aterese ya Bitcoin
where:
• Diseva tšeo di dirago gore go nyalantšha le didikologo di šome.
  • Maina a didomeine, gore myquietbible.com e tšwele pele e šoma.
  • Imeile ye e romelago dikhoutu tša go tsena.
never: Ga go se sengwe ka Beibeleng se se tla notlelwago le gatee. Go neela ke ditebogo, e sego thekete ya go tsena, gomme ga go se se fetogago ka go app ge o neela goba o sa neele.
tax: My Quiet Bible ga se mokgatlo wa kgaugelo wo o ngwadišitšwego, ka fao dimpho ga di fokotše motšhelo wa gago.
otherH: Ditsela tše dingwe tša go thuša
other:
• Rapelela modiro wo, le batho bao ba balago ka wona.
  • Romela myquietbible.com go motho yo a ka ratago Beibele ye e homotšego.
